jobs.prompt: Edit this exact photo, keep everything the same: the same room, camera, framing, every object, the same dark noir night mood, the same faint cold grey light through blinds from the right, the same soft glow of the monitor, the green desk lamp still switched off with a dark shade. Keep the overall image dark and moody, muted colours, deep shadows, film grain. Monitor screen plain soft light, no content. No other new objects, no people, no text, no logos.
